'''Weyn Jarl''' was an untrustworthy [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> while on<ref name="Viper's Den">{{SWIA|set=Core Set|mission=Viper's Den}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Planet">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="Viper's Den" /> Jarl acquired an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] and brought it to an abandoned junk shop where he began to dismantle the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Jarl was eventually located by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] to which he barricaded himself in the shop<ref name="Campaign Guide" /> and sent a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]] to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Rebel High Command]] stating that he had sensitive information on Imperial [[Trooper/Legends|troop]] movements.<ref name="Viper's Den" /> High Command then sent a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Rebels to locate and rescue Jarl, to which he sent one last transmission telling them to hurry. [[Standard hour/Legends|Hours]] later, the group of Rebels arrive and locate the building Jarl was inside, with Imperial forces currently working on cutting open the door. The squad defeated the forces and destroyed the door, only to find Weyn Jarl [[Death/Legends|dead]] on the floor from several [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] wounds, having been shot at through the walls of the shop.<ref name="Campaign Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Weyn Jarl was mention in the ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' [[Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set|Core Set]]<ref name="Campaign Guide" /> released on [[December 15]], [[2014]],<ref name="Begin Your Assault">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/12/15/begin-your-assault|text=Begin Your Assault}}</ref> on the card "[https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/Viper's_Den Viper's Den]"<ref name="Viper's Den" /> and in the Campaign Guide.<ref name="Campaign Guide" />
